notes: «وسأله سماعة بن مهران» names the asker; the Imam is not named. The first-person «قال قلت» is Sama'a's own speech, so whether he is the reporting last link (rule 6) or only the questioner (rule 5) is not settled.

«وسأله سماعة بن مهران» names the asker; the Imam is not named. The first-person «قال قلت» is Sama'a's own speech, so whether he is the reporting last link (rule 6) or only the questioner (rule 5) is not settled.
«وَ سَأَلَهُ سَمَاعَةُ بْنُ مِهْرَانَ» is a question to an unnamed Imam (pronoun only); the asker is not a link (rule 5) and the Imam is not named, so no chain can be read from the text
